review_candidates.description: Senior Structural Design Engineer — Qatar Projects Location: Egypt Employment: Full-time Scope: Complete structural design, engineering calculations, construction drawings, and structural shop drawings for projects in Qatar. Salary: Based on experience, technical capability, and portfolio. About the Role We are looking for an experienced Structural Design Engineer based in Egypt who can independently develop complete structural packages for our projects in Qatar, from the initial structural concept through detailed design, shop drawings, and technical support during construction. The successful candidate must have strong knowledge of Qatar’s applicable construction specifications, structural design requirements, and submission procedures , together with practical understanding of how structures are built. This is a complete structural engineering role—not a drafting-only or software-modelling position. The engineer must be capable of developing the structural solution, verifying calculations, producing coordinated drawings, and resolving technical issues. Key Responsibilities 1. Complete Structural Design and Engineering Develop structural concepts and detailed designs for villas, residential buildings, commercial projects, extensions, and alterations. Design reinforced-concrete and structural-steel elements, including foundations, columns, beams, slabs, shear walls, staircases, retaining walls, basements, and associated structures. Coordinate specialist elements and connections where required. Select suitable structural systems that balance safety, buildability, cost, and architectural intent. Assess existing structures and proposed modifications using verified information, arranging additional surveys or investigations where necessary. 2. Structural Analysis and Calculations Prepare structural analysis models, design-basis reports, loading schedules, and detailed calculation packages. Assess gravity loads, wind loads, seismic effects where applicable, and relevant load combinations. Check strength, stability, deflection, cracking, punching shear, and other applicable design criteria. Develop foundation designs using the project’s approved geotechnical information, considering bearing capacity, settlement, groundwater, and uplift where relevant. Independently verify critical software results through engineering checks. 3. Qatar Codes, Specifications, and Approval Coordination Demonstrate working knowledge of Qatar Construction Specifications, including QCS 2024 , and confirm the applicable edition, amendments, and project requirements before commencing design. qcs.qs.gov.qa Work with the structural design standards adopted for each project, including relevant ACI, ASCE, AISC, British Standards, or Eurocodes , as applicable. Clearly document the agreed design basis and avoid inconsistent use of different code provisions. Prepare structural submission packages, respond to review comments, and coordinate with the responsible Qatar consultant and project team through checking, approval, and construction-stage revisions. 4. Detailed Design and Construction Drawings Prepare complete structural drawing packages, including setting-out plans, foundation layouts, framing plans, sections, schedules, reinforcement details, general notes, and structural specifications. Ensure drawings clearly communicate dimensions, levels, material requirements, connections, and construction details. Maintain consistency between calculations, analysis models, architectural drawings, and issued structural documents. Prepare structural quantities and support bills of quantities, tender queries, and technically justified value-engineering proposals. 5. Structural Shop / Workshop Drawings Personally prepare and review construction-ready structural shop drawings , rather than relying only on schematic design drawings. Cover formwork layouts, detailed reinforcement arrangements, bar marks, bar bending schedules, laps, anchorage, couplers, construction joints, embedded items, openings, and coordinated levels. For structural-steel works, develop or coordinate fabrication and erection details, member schedules, connections, base plates, and anchor bolts within the agreed design responsibility. Check constructability, reinforcement congestion, installation access, and consistency with approved designs. Coordinate specialist detailing and secure the required review before drawings are released for execution. 6. Architectural, MEP, and Specialist Coordination Coordinate structural layouts with architecture, interiors, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing designs. Resolve conflicts involving columns, beams, slab depths, ceiling heights, staircases, lift shafts, service openings, and equipment loads before construction. Coordinate structural interfaces for façade supports, canopies, pergolas, swimming pools, water tanks, and specialist installations where included in the project scope. Identify missing information early and maintain a clear technical-query register. 7. Construction Support, Quality Control, and Deliverables Provide technical support to the Qatar site team, respond to requests for information, review proposed changes, and issue coordinated revisions through the approved review process. Investigate reported site discrepancies using verified measurements, photographs, inspection records, and specialist input where needed. Maintain drawing registers, revision histories, calculation records, and organised project files. Deliver editable drawings, native analysis models, calculation reports, and PDF packages. Prepare as-built documentation from verified site records and ensure every submission is checked before issue. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering , with substantial experience in structural analysis, detailed design, and structural shop drawings. Demonstrated ability to deliver a complete structural package independently , supported by practical construction knowledge. Previous Qatar project experience is strongly preferred; working knowledge of Qatar requirements is essential. Strong capability in reinforced-concrete design, reinforcement detailing, foundation engineering, and structural-steel design and coordination . Ability to manage multiple projects, meet submission deadlines, communicate clearly with the Qatar team, and take responsibility for technical accuracy. Professional English is required; Arabic is an advantage. Software Proficiency Strong proficiency in ETABS, SAFE, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Excel is required. Experience with Revit Structure and coordinated structural modelling is highly desirable. Working knowledge of SAP2000, STAAD.Pro, Robot Structural Analysis, Tekla Structures, or connection-design software is an advantage, depending on the candidate’s specialization. Candidates must understand and validate their calculations—not simply produce software outputs. How to Apply Send your CV and a technical portfolio showing structural calculations, design drawings, shop drawings, and bar bending schedules that you personally prepared to: ammar@thedastudio.com Email subject: Structural Design Engineer — Egypt / Qatar Projects Please include your current location in Egypt, Qatar/GCC project experience, software proficiency, notice period, and expected monthly salary in EGP . Share only portfolio material you are authorised to disclose, with confidential information removed.

review_candidates.company: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
review_candidates.description: Myndigheten för civilt försvar Myndigheten för civilt försvar är den ledande, inriktande och samordnande myndigheten i det civila försvaret. Vi säkerställer att samhället är förberett för kris, höjd beredskap och krig. Vill du tillsammans med oss stärka samhället i att förebygga och hantera olyckor, kriser och konsekvenser av krig? Då kanske du är vår nästa kollega? Myndigheten för civilt försvar genomför insatser över hela världen. Sektionen för civilt stöd till Ukraina ansvarar för myndighetens civila stöd till Ukraina och närliggande länder. Som samordnare blir du en central del av sektionens arbete. Sedan Rysslands fullskaliga invasion i februari 2022 har Myndigheten för civilt försvar bidragit med omfattande civilskydds-, humanitära- och utvecklingsinsatser i Ukraina. Verksamheten har vuxit genom utökade regeringsuppdrag och är organiserad inom avdelningen för operativ planering och hantering, enheten för genomförande (C3). Den 1 juni etablerades en ny sektion med fokus på civilt stöd till Ukraina. Sedan 2024 har myndigheten en samordnare placerad vid Sveriges ambassad i Kyjiv för att stärka effektiviteten, långsiktigheten och samordningen av det svenska stödet. Samordnaren ingår i Ukrainasektionens ledningsgrupp och arbetar nära både kollegor i Sverige och myndighetens övriga medarbetare på plats i Ukraina. Ditt ansvar och dina arbetsuppgifter Som samordnare arbetar du med övergripande strategiska frågor som rör myndighetens samlade engagemang i Ukraina. Utveckling av partnerskap med ukrainska myndigheter och organisationer är en central del av tjänsten. Du bidrar både till utvecklingen av myndighetens insatsverksamhet i Ukraina och till att ta tillvara och omsätta erfarenheter från Ukraina i det svenska civila försvaret. Du bidrar också till ambassadens arbete och representerar Sverige, exempelvis inom givarsamordning och andra frågor som rör myndighetens ansvarsområden. I Rollen Kommer Du Bland Annat Att utveckla och stödja insatser som möter centrala behov i Ukraina tillsammans med kollegor vid Ukrainasektionen och Sveriges ambassad i Kyjiv ingå i ledningsgruppen för Sektionen för civilt stöd till Ukraina fungera som myndighetens lokala kontaktpunkt i Ukraina och som ambassadens kontaktpunkt i civilskyddsfrågor bygga och utveckla relationer med ukrainska partners, internationella aktörer och andra relevanta samarbetspartners bidra till samordning mellan myndighetens insatser och andra svenska initiativ i Ukraina följa upp verksamheten, bidra till lärande och ta tillvara erfarenheter från Ukraina för utvecklingen av det svenska civila försvaret bidra till en stärkt lägesbild genom analys av utvecklingen i Ukraina och anpassning av myndighetens insatser utifrån rådande behov stödja och samordna besök från myndigheten och prioriterade samarbetspartners Anställningen innebär resor utanför Kyjiv, till både lugnare och mer osäkra delar av landet. Säkerhetsarrangemangen vid tjänsteresorna kommer att variera beroende på vistelseort och kan ske både inom ambassadens såväl som myndighetens säkerhetsramar. Tjänsteresor till tredjeland, främst inom Europa, kan också förekomma. Dina kunskaper och kompetenser Vi Söker Dig Som Har relevant akademisk utbildning eller motsvarande kunskaper som arbetsgivaren finner likvärdiga gedigen erfarenhet av arbete med krishantering, civilskydd, internationellt utvecklingssamarbete, internationella insatser eller civilt försvar i internationell kontext erfarenhet av att verka professionellt i en internationell kontext med medel eller hög säkerhetsrisk dokumenterad god analytisk och strukturerad förmåga mycket god kommunikativ förmåga samt förståelse för vikten av korrekt informationsdelning och ett helhetsperspektiv erfarenhet av att utföra ditt arbete under svåra och krävande förhållanden men ändå med god förmåga till flexibilitet erfarenhet av att skapa och upprätthålla nätverk du har mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har erfarenhet av arbete vid svensk myndighet eller regeringskansli tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta med eller i Ukraina kunskap om Myndigheten för civilt försvars insatsverksamhet och/eller övriga centrala uppdrag god förmåga att uttrycka dig på Ukrainska, både i tal och skrift I allt vårt arbete, både internt och externt, ska vi agera utifrån den statliga värdegrunden. Som alla medarbetare och ledare hos oss förväntas du agera utifrån myndighetens förhållningssätt. Förhållningssätten gäller i vardag, kris och krig. De ska ses som en helhet och bygger på varandra; samarbetsinriktad – proaktiv - handlingskraftig. Läs mer om våra förhållningssätt Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha god samarbetsförmåga och kunna bygga förtroendefulla relationer med såväl interna som externa aktörer. Du är initiativtagande, flexibel och har förmåga att hantera komplexa frågeställningar genom att kombinera ett praktiskt och analytiskt arbetssätt. Rollen kräver också gott omdöme, lyhördhet och förmåga att prioritera mellan arbetsuppgifter i en föränderlig miljö. Du arbetar strukturerat, har en god helhetssyn och kan leverera resultat av hög kvalitet även under tidspress. Om anställningen För denna roll tecknas ett tidsbegränsat URA-kontrakt på 12 månader, med möjlighet till förlängning. Din placeringsort är Kyjiv, Ukraina. Statliga arbetsgivare som har personal stationerad utomlands har möjlighet att betala ut fyra skattefria resor till och från stationeringsorten. Tjänsteresor/rotationsresor till Sverige enligt ambassadens cykel och riktlinjer. Organisatoriskt kommer du tillhöra Sektionen för civilt stöd till Ukraina och arbeta nära chef och medarbetare på sektionen. Majoriteten av våra anställningar innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Vid placering i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. De flesta medarbetare på Myndigheten för civilt försvar är krigsplacerade. Att vara krigsplacerad innebär att du är ianspråktagen för att tjänstgöra vid höjd beredskap och krig. Om oss Myndigheten har fyra insatssektioner och hanterar genom sin insatsverksamhet i genomsnitt cirka 80 pågående insatser i ett 30-tal länder. På sektionen för civilt stöd till Ukraina är vi cirka 20 medarbetare och vi finns i både Karlstad och Stockholm. Sektionen ansvarar för att koordinera och samordna myndighetens stöd till och samarbete med Ukraina samt att representera myndigheten inom Team Swedens Ukrainastöd. Vidare ansvarar sektionen för att facilitera och skapa möjligheter för myndigheten och det svenska beredskapssystemet att tillvarata hemtagning av lärdomar och erfarenheter från Ukraina till det svenska civila försvaret. Alla vi som arbetar på Myndigheten för civilt försvar förväntas och ska bidra till ökad jämställdhet och likabehandling för en arbetsmiljö och ett samhälle fritt från diskriminering. Läs mer om vår organisation, förmåner och hur det är att arbeta hos oss Vill du veta mer? Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta sektionschef Christian Wåhlstedt. Fackliga företrädare är Carin Hammarbo (Saco-S), Peter Nytting (ST) och Ann-Britt Paradis (SEKO). Samtliga nås via växelnummer 0771-240 240. TL;DR If you want to shape the future of work in Africa, there is no role that will put you closer to the centre of the sector’s learning-for-action agenda. About Prosper Global Barely enough is not enough for anyone. Prosper Global is a humanitarian organization working alongside communities facing conflict, climate change, and economic hardship to meet urgent needs and create the conditions for lasting progress. Today's challenges demand new solutions, so we pair local knowledge with global resources to help communities build what's needed, test what's possible, and scale what's proven so that people everywhere can pursue a full life on their own terms. In 2026, we changed our name from Mercy Corps to Prosper Global, to reflect our belief that when every community can prosper, all of humanity moves forward. About Prosper Global, The Jobtech Alliance And DAWN Prosper Global (formerly Mercy Corps) is a global humanitarian organization working in over 40 countries at the front lines of today’s biggest crises. Prosper Global has built a reputation for innovative economic development programming, particularly working with start-ups, and hosts a venture capital arm called Prosper Global Ventures. In late 2021, Prosper Global launched the Jobtech Alliance, a Pan-African ecosystem-building initiative around inclusive jobtech in Africa. The Jobtech Alliance has a portfolio of grants for acceleration activities with jobtech startups, and wider ecosystem-building . We learn by doing, conduct research to better understand what makes these innovations work (or not), and explore emerging themes to help define and guide the sector. Digital Advancement for Women Now (DAWN) is a four-year project in Nigeria, funded by the Mastercard Foundation and implemented within the Jobtech Alliance. It enables underserved young people, with a particular focus on young women, alongside refugees and displaced people and persons with disabilities, to access safe, inclusive and dignified work through jobtech platforms. Position Summary As the Jobtech Alliance Research & Insights Director, you will lead the insight generation, research and learning strategy and its implementation at the Jobtech Alliance, including on the DAWN project. You collaborate with different teams to draw insights from our ecosystem and acceleration activities and craft our learning-for-action plan, oversee research, with a particular focus on young women. You will work with ecosystem team members to coordinate our dissemination and advocacy plans to ensure our research outputs spur action across the entire jobtech ecosystem, and translate to impactful outcomes for young people. We operate as a ‘do-tank’ rather than a ‘think-tank’ - our insights need to be operationally impactful. You will often have a role in moving research into practice, as well as vice-versa. You will be traveling up to 20% of the time across the continent, including regularly within Nigeria. Essential Responsibilities This role at the Jobtech Alliance will provide you with access to unrivaled, cutting-edge information resources, data and influence across the jobtech ecosystem in Africa. Access to the highest-potential jobtech startups across the continent working to make their business models more scalable and inclusive The most comprehensive dataset on gig workers in Africa (1M+ workers) with rich details on engagement patterns and earnings Learnings and data from implementation, tracking how young people move into dignified platform work, and which approaches work best Deep relationships with players across the jobtech ecosystem and beyond for research dissemination, partnerships and advocacy Close interaction with the venture building team, which works with and within the highest potential platforms on the continent. You will have the opportunity to influence and execute action-oriented research and learning to solve problems across the jobtech ecosystem: Internal use cases: where the Jobtech Alliance team requires insights that are material to the organisation’s operations, e.g. guiding our strategy around platforms in international migration Partner use cases: where partner jobtech start-ups or donor funders (including the Mastercard Foundation) require insights for their decision making, e.g. how best to support female gig workers increase their platform earning Ecosystem use cases: where learning products are required to shift mindsets and get ecosystem actors to do something differently, e.g. helping startup entrepreneurs to replicate best practices around vetting Communication use cases: shorter-form thought leadership articles that raise the Jobtech Alliance’s profile, e.g. guidance on how to measure what counts as a job in gig platforms Key Responsibilities RESEARCH AND INSIGHTS STRATEGY- 25% Craft and continuously refine our research and insights strategy (updated at least quarterly), identifying the different research and insight use cases and the appropriate methodologies, formats, dissemination channels and advocacy required to translate research outputs to action. Shape the overarching learning-for-action plan of the Jobtech Alliance. Identify emerging themes coming out of our work, as well as upon the wider jobtech horizon, which require further research. Lead the research and learning plan and priorities for DAWN, including the Learning Pilot’s key questions: how to define and measure dignified and fulfilling work, which inclusion interventions improve outcomes for disadvantaged users, and which sectors, platform models and pathways deliver the strongest work-quality and earnings outcomes. Work with venture building teams and startups to identify the questions each innovation sprint should answer, and turn the findings into lessons for the startup and the wider sector Advise the team on new issues they should be addressing in their work, based on reading emerging research in the jobtech space. CONDUCTING RESEARCH AND OVERSEEING RESEARCH OUTPUTS - 50% Lead research on varying themes with acceleration start-up partners, from product design, to business model strategy, user-level impact, and/or operations. This involves strategizing research approaches and methodologies in a manner that is adapted to each innovation project’s needs, and would involve data collection activities with start-ups, the venture building team, and users themselves. Oversee the analysis, synthesis, and production of research and learning outputs as a primary author for various forms of audiences and channels, including long-form reports, blogs, and other communication mediums for knowledge products. Our content will primarily be in the form of 5-10 page learning reports, and 1-2 page blogs, with a few longer-form research products. Lead the evidence, analysis and recommendations for the Year 1 Learning Pilot evaluation, which informs the Mastercard Foundation’s decisions on refinement and scale-up. Manage researchers, consultants and primary data collectors, where required,, as part of the research output production process. Deliver DAWN’s portfolio of research and learning products including studies that centre the voices of disadvantaged young women, refugees and displaced people and persons with disabilities in Nigeria, and ensure all data collection with these participants is ethical, inclusive and consistent with safeguarding and data protection requirements. SHAPE DISSEMENTATION AND INFLUENCE - 25% Work with the Ecosystem and Communications teams to decide who needs to see each piece of research, what we want them to do with it, and how best to reach them. This could include workshops, webinars, events, or campaigns. Plan and deliver content plan for the Jobtech Alliance’s flagship Africa Jobtech learning convening, bringing together platforms, skilling providers, financial institutions, policymakers and funders. Lead advocacy efforts to feed research findings into the decision-making process of ecosystem actors, where identified in the strategy. Oversee our quarterly research and content calendar. Ensure that research and content (blogs etc) are on course. Ensure quality and relevance of blogs and learning products produced by other team members. Contribute the learning and evidence sections of DAWN’s reports to the Mastercard Foundation, working with the DAWN Project Director, and present findings to the Foundation and other stakeholders. Function as a learning focal point for engagement with external stakeholders. Attend local events, meetings and networking activities. Where suitable, convene researchers in the jobtech space to move forward learning plan and priorities, or to foster collaboration. Safeguarding Responsibilities Actively learns about safeguarding and integrates it into their work, including safeguarding risks and mitigations related to their area of work. Practices the values of Mercy Corps including respecting the dignity and well-being of participants and fellow team members. Encourages openness and communication in their team; encourages team members to submit reports if they have any concerns using reporting mechanisms e.g., Integrity Hotline and other options. Supervisory Responsibility Department Lead: Impact & Data (TBD), Researchers, Consultants, Enumerators, Accountability Reports Directly To: Jobtech Alliance Program Director Works Directly With: Start-ups, External partners, Results Measurement & Learning Lead, Venture builders, Ecosystem team (Community & Communications), DAWN Project Director, BFA Global and ImpactHER (consortium partners), Mastercard Foundation. Accountability to Participants and Stakeholders Prosper Global team members are expected to support all efforts toward accountability, specifically to our program participants, community partners, other stakeholders, and to international standards guiding international relief and development work. Demonstrated ability to develop tailored research and learning strategies covering use cases, formats and dissemination plans Demonstrated familiarity with both business strategies and decisions, as well as user-level impact. Experience conducting research with young people, ideally with young women, refugees and displaced people or persons with disabilities, applying ethical research, safeguarding and data protection standards. Excellent communication and writing skills, with a keen ability to synthesize and present complex data in a simple, compelling, meaningful way. Must be a strong self-starter. review_candidates.title: Quality Supervisor
review_candidates.description: About the Role CJR Renewables is looking for a Quality Supervisor to join our team and support the delivery of high-quality wind and photovoltaic projects across our region. In this role, you will make sure our projects meet CJR's quality standards, as well as national and international legislation, helping us maintain the certifications needed to operate successfully. What You'll Do Review new project proposals and clarification requests to spot potential gaps early Prepare and maintain Quality Plans, procedures, and inspection/testing plans in line with local law and client requirements Monitor quality indicators and support risk and opportunity management across projects Manage non-conformities, complaints, and improvement opportunities Carry out quality inspections and audits on site, and prepare clear reports Support the pre-qualification and evaluation of subcontractors and suppliers Check that equipment used on site has valid calibration certificates Keep project quality documentation organized and up to date (SharePoint) Contribute to staff training needs and participate in training program design Build strong working relationships with clients, project teams, and subcontractors Support the preparation of the project's final QHSE dossier ("As Built" documentation) Promote continuous improvement and help implement Kaizen initiatives What We're Looking For min. 2 years of experience in quality management, ideally in construction, EPC, or renewable energy projects Engineering education Good knowledge of QHSE standards and local legal/regulatory requirements Fluent in English and Romanian as must-have Strong organizational skills and attention to detail Comfortable working with technical documentation and site inspections Good communication skills, able to work with both internal teams and clients What we offer Salary adequate to your experience and skills Benefits: private medical health care, gift card for the Christmas Accommodation close to the site if needed Meal allowance Opportunity for professional development and continuous improvement of qualifications Integration in a solid, multinational, and growing company Everyday contact with foreign languages Why Join CJR Renewables Be part of an international team driving the energy transition forward. You'll work on meaningful projects, grow your expertise in quality management, and contribute directly to the successful delivery of renewable energy infrastructure.
